name: mdopen
description: Quickly render a Markdown file as styled HTML and open it in the browser.

scripts.check: bash -n mdopen && cp assets/mdopen.css /tmp/mdopen.css && cp assets/mdopen-overrides.css /tmp/mdopen-overrides.css && cp assets/styles/demo.css /tmp/demo.css && cp assets/styles/readthedocs.css /tmp/readthedocs.css && mkdir -p /tmp/fonts && cp assets/styles/fonts/* /tmp/fonts/ && bun renderer.js README.md templates/mdopen.html /tmp/mdopen-check.html README mdopen.css readthedocs
